evidenceSheet.title: Evidence details
evidenceSheet.description: View collection evidence and lineage for the current field, rule, or item.

description.running: The pinned active rule is executing; the latest run and checkpoint update on completion.
description.published: The active rule and collection scope are in effect; run now or inspect the latest results.
description.readyReview: Candidate fields and samples are ready; complete manual decisions before publishing.
description.exploring: The system is analyzing the entry, pagination, detail links, and field quality.
description.draft: Confirm the collection brief, entry URL, and run scope, then generate candidate rules.

facts.awaitingReview: Review after candidate rules are generated
facts.publishToRun: Run immediately after the rule is published

empty.title: Run in progress
empty.description: Live phases and metrics appear at the top of the page; the latest results update here after completion.

nextStep.readyReviewDescription: Open "Rule review" to resolve pending field decisions; technical evidence expands from the right only when needed.
nextStep.designDescription: Confirm the source definition and collection scope first, then start rule generation.

description.published: Runs always use this reviewed rule; it never changes automatically.
description.candidate: Publish once field review is complete.

decisionSummary.excluded: {{total}} optional fields excluded; the rest passed

review.clearDescription: All quality warnings have been risk-accepted or the fields excluded; the candidate rule can be published.
review.sectionTitle: Confirm the output contract field by field
review.sectionDescription: Selectors, DOM snippets, and source evidence open on demand without cluttering the main review table.
review.samplesDescription: Select a sample to view item lineage, detail URL, and collection version.

flow.singleTitle: Entry fetch and field extraction complete in one stage
flow.listDetailTitle: List discovery and detail collection complete in one run
flow.singleDescription: A single-page Source extracts fields directly, still bounded by the pinned RuleVersion, request budget, and quality finalization.
flow.listDetailDescription: Both stages share the pinned RuleVersion, request budget, and final quality finalization; they are not split into two independent tasks.
flow.singleQualityNote: Single-page fields go straight into type, identity, and quality gate checks.
flow.listSampleNote: Sampled {{listPages}} list pages and discovered {{detailUrls}} detail links.
flow.detailBoundaryNote: Every detail URL re-runs allowedHosts, redirect, and request budget checks.

definition.title: Collector definition
definition.dialogDescription: The requirement and data contract stay unchanged; the collector name identifies the source, while the source collection brief and entry URL jointly determine the candidate rule.
definition.name: Collector name
definition.newRuleDescription: The current candidate becomes invalid; the published rule stays immutable and is kept as historical evidence.

rule.emptyDescription: The system will analyze the entry, pagination, detail links, and output fields; results enter manual review.
rule.rebuildWarning: The requirement input has changed; historical versions remain traceable but will not run again. Regenerate and publish.

regenerate.dialogDescription: The system revisits the Source and replaces the current candidate. Published rules and historical runs are unchanged; the new candidate must be reviewed and published again.

editor.dialogDescription: Modify selectors and pagination; saving produces a new candidate for review.

schedule.title: Scheduled runs
schedule.description: Controls when the collector runs automatically; if a previous run is still in progress, this round is skipped and never collected concurrently.
schedule.dialogDescription: Common frequencies are enough; cron is only needed in custom mode.
schedule.cronFormatHint: 5 fields: minute hour day month weekday
schedule.skipWhenRunning: Skipped while a run is active

policy.title: Collection scope and increments
policy.description: The first run looks back over a time window; later runs look back from the successful checkpoint while pagination stays pinned by the published rule.
policy.dialogDescription: Saved immediately for subsequent runs; historical runs are unchanged.

fetchingList.detail: Transport protocol and host boundary confirmed; reading the Source response.

discoveringDetails.title: Identifying pagination and detail links
discoveringDetails.detail: Generating the list selector, pagination strategy, and detail URL rules.

fetchingDetails.title: Collecting detail samples
fetchingDetails.detail: Each detail URL re-runs network boundary and request budget checks.

validating.detail: Candidate fields are passing type, identity, and quality gates.

finalizing.title: Freezing the candidate rule
finalizing.detail: GatherSpec, evidence summary, and quality warnings are being finalized.

completed.title: Candidate rule ready
completed.detail: Field preview and collection evidence are now in the review area.

queued.title: Run queued
queued.detail: Acquiring the execution lease and pinning the active rule.

fetchingList.title: Executing the published rule
fetchingList.detail: Crawlee is fetching entry and pagination responses.

discoveringDetails.title: Discovering detail URLs
discoveringDetails.detail: Detail links are being normalized, deduplicated, and same-origin checked.

fetchingDetails.title: Fetching detail pages
fetchingDetails.detail: Detail requests are bounded by budget, retries, and redirect policy.

validating.title: Running quality checks
validating.detail: Extracted results are passing type, identity, and required gates.

finalizing.title: Finalizing quality decisions
finalizing.detail: The accepted and rejected sets are being frozen; no delivery side effects yet.

completed.title: Run terminal state recorded
completed.detail: Results, evidence, and recovery info are now queryable.

published.resultsDescription: Only the latest 5 items are shown; full execution evidence and quality stats live in the run details.
published.readyDescription: Click "Run now" to execute one collection with the fixed rule version and inspect the results.

publish.title: Publish rule?
publish.description: Rule content becomes immutable after publishing. Confirm field decisions and quality check results.
